commits.content:
name: password_manager
description: "A new Flutter project."
publish_to: 'none'
version: 0.1.0+1

environment:
  sdk: ^3.11.1

dependencies:
  bloc: ^9.2.0
  catch_and_flow: ^1.2.1
  equatable: ^2.0.8
  file_picker: ^10.3.10
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_bloc: ^9.1.1
  flutter_autofill_service: ^0.21.0
  flutter_secure_storage: ^10.0.0
  google_sign_in: ^7.2.0
  get_it: ^9.2.1
  google_fonts: ^8.0.2
  crypto: ^3.0.7
  http: ^1.6.0
  kdbx: ^2.4.2
  local_auth: ^3.0.1
  loggy: ^2.0.3
  otp: ^3.2.0
  mobile_scanner: ^7.2.0
  oauth2: ^2.0.5
  path: ^1.9.1
  path_provider: ^2.1.5
  shared_preferences: ^2.5.4
  stream_transform: ^2.1.1
  url_launcher: ^6.3.2
  phosphor_flutter: ^2.1.0

dev_dependencies:
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_lints: ^6.0.0
  flutter_launcher_icons: ^0.14.4

flutter:
  uses-material-design: true

flutter_launcher_icons:
  image_path: assets/logo/keyvault-source.png
  android: true
  ios: true
  web:
    generate: true
  windows:
    generate: true
  macos:
    generate: true
  remove_alpha_ios: true
